lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have der' : Typing Γ t τ := der
  induction der' <;> subst eq
  case var mem => grind
  case app t₁ _ _ t₂ l r ih_l ih_r =>
    right
    cases ih_l rfl l with
    | inl val_l =>
        cases ih_r rfl r with
        | inl val_r =>
            have ⟨σ, t₁, eq⟩ := l.canonical_form_abs val_l
            exists t₁ ^ᵗᵗ t₂
            grind
        | inr red_r =>
            obtain ⟨t₂', _⟩ := red_r
            exists t₁.app t₂'
            grind
    | inr red_l =>
        obtain ⟨t₁', _⟩ := red_l
        exists t₁'.app t₂
        grind
  case tapp σ' der _ ih =>
    right
    specialize ih rfl der
    cases ih with
    | inl val =>
        obtain ⟨_, t, _⟩ := der.canonical_form_tabs val
        exists t ^ᵗᵞ σ'
        grind
    | inr red =>
        obtain ⟨t', _⟩ := red
        exists .tapp t' σ'
        grind
  case let' t₁ σ t₂ τ L der _ ih _ =>
    right
    cases ih rfl der with
    | inl _ =>
        exists t₂ ^ᵗᵗ t₁
        grind
    | inr red =>
        obtain ⟨t₁', _⟩ := red
        exists t₁'.let' t₂
        grind
  case inl der _ ih =>
    cases (ih rfl der) with
    | inl val => grind
    | inr red =>
        right
        obtain ⟨t', _⟩ := red
        exists .inl t'
        grind
  case inr der _ ih =>
    cases (ih rfl der) with
    | inl val => grind
    | inr red =>
        right
        obtain ⟨t', _⟩ := red
        exists .inr t'
        grind
  case case t₁ _ _ t₂ _ t₃ _ der _ _ ih _ _ =>
    right
    cases ih rfl der with
    | inl val =>
        have ⟨t₁, lr⟩ := der.canonical_form_sum val
        cases lr <;> [exists t₂ ^ᵗᵗ t₁; exists t₃ ^ᵗᵗ t₁] <;> grind
    | inr red =>
        obtain ⟨t₁', _⟩ := red
        exists t₁'.case t₂ t₃
        grind
  case sub => grind
  case abs σ _ τ L _ _=>
    left
    constructor
    apply LC.abs L
    · grind only [→ wf, cases Term.LC]
    · grind
  case tabs L _ _=>
    left
    constructor
    apply LC.tabs L
    · grind only [→ wf, cases Term.LC]
    · grind

lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have : Typing Γ t τ := der
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var => simp_all
  case app t₁ _ _ t₂ l r ih_l ih_r =>
    right
    rcases ih_l rfl l with val_l | ⟨t₁', red_l⟩
    · rcases ih_r rfl r with val_r | ⟨t₂', red_r⟩
      · obtain ⟨σ, u, h⟩ := l.canonical_form_abs val_l
        use u ^ᵗᵗ t₂
        grind
      · exact ⟨t₁.app t₂', Red.appᵣ val_l red_r⟩
    · exact ⟨t₁'.app t₂, Red.appₗ r.wf.2.1 red_l⟩
  case tapp σ' d sub ih =>
    have lcσ : σ'.LC := (sub.wf [] σ' _).2.1.lc
    right
    rcases ih rfl d with val | ⟨u, step⟩
    · obtain ⟨δ, v, h⟩ := d.canonical_form_tabs val
      exact ⟨v ^ᵗᵞ σ', by grind⟩
    · exact ⟨.tapp u σ', Red.tapp lcσ step⟩
  case let' t₁ σ t₂ τ L der h ih _ =>
    have ⟨_, hb⟩ := Term.body_let.mp (Typing.let' L der h).wf.2.1
    right
    rcases ih rfl der with val | ⟨t₁', step⟩
    · exact ⟨t₂ ^ᵗᵗ t₁, Red.let_body val hb⟩
    · exact ⟨t₁'.let' t₂, Red.let_bind step hb⟩
  case inl der _ ih =>
    rcases ih rfl der with val | ⟨u, step⟩
    · grind
    · exact Or.inr ⟨.inl u, Red.inl step⟩
  case inr der _ ih =>
    rcases ih rfl der with val | ⟨u, step⟩
    · grind
    · exact Or.inr ⟨.inr u, Red.inr step⟩
  case case t₁ σ τ t₂ δ t₃ L der h₂ h₃ ih _ _ =>
    have ⟨_, hb₂, hb₃⟩ := Term.body_case.mp (Typing.case L der h₂ h₃).wf.2.1
    right
    rcases ih rfl der with val | ⟨u, step⟩
    · rcases der.canonical_form_sum val with ⟨v, h | h⟩
      · subst t₁
        cases val with
        | inl vv => exact ⟨t₂ ^ᵗᵗ v, Red.case_inl vv hb₂ hb₃⟩
      · subst t₁
        cases val with
        | inr vv => exact ⟨t₃ ^ᵗᵗ v, Red.case_inr vv hb₂ hb₃⟩
    · exact ⟨.case u t₂ t₃, Red.case step hb₂ hb₃⟩

  case tabs => grind

lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have : Typing Γ t τ := der
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var => grind
  case app t₁ _ _ t₂ l r ih_l ih_r =>
    right
    rcases ih_l rfl l with val_l | ⟨t₁', red_l⟩
    · rcases ih_r rfl r with val_r | ⟨t₂', red_r⟩
      · obtain ⟨σ, u, h⟩ := l.canonical_form_abs val_l
        use u ^ᵗᵗ t₂
        grind
      · exact ⟨t₁.app t₂', Red.appᵣ val_l red_r⟩
    · exact ⟨t₁'.app t₂, Red.appₗ r.wf.2.1 red_l⟩
  case tapp σ' d sub ih =>
    have lcσ : σ'.LC := (sub.wf [] σ' _).2.1.lc
    right
    rcases ih rfl d with val | ⟨u, step⟩
    · obtain ⟨δ, v, h⟩ := d.canonical_form_tabs val
      exact ⟨v ^ᵗᵞ σ', by grind⟩
    · exact ⟨.tapp u σ', Red.tapp lcσ step⟩
  case let' t₁ σ t₂ τ L der h ih _ =>
    have ⟨_, hb⟩ := Term.body_let.mp (Typing.let' L der h).wf.2.1
    right
    rcases ih rfl der with val | ⟨t₁', step⟩
    · exact ⟨t₂ ^ᵗᵗ t₁, Red.let_body val hb⟩
    · exact ⟨t₁'.let' t₂, Red.let_bind step hb⟩
  case inl der _ ih =>
    rcases ih rfl der with val | ⟨u, step⟩
    · grind
    · right
    exact ⟨.inl u, Red.inl step⟩
  case inr der _ ih =>
    rcases ih rfl der with val | ⟨u, step⟩
    · grind
    · right
    exact ⟨.inr u, Red.inr step⟩
  case case t₁ σ τ t₂ δ t₃ L der h₂ h₃ ih _ _ =>
    have ⟨_, hb₂, hb₃⟩ := Term.body_case.mp (Typing.case L der h₂ h₃).wf.2.1
    right
    rcases ih rfl der with val | ⟨u, step⟩
    · rcases der.canonical_form_sum val with ⟨v, h | h⟩
      · subst t₁
        cases val with
        | inl vv => exact ⟨t₂ ^ᵗᵗ v, Red.case_inl vv hb₂ hb₃⟩
      · subst t₁
        cases val with
        | inr vv => exact ⟨t₃ ^ᵗᵗ v, Red.case_inr vv hb₂ hb₃⟩
    · exact ⟨.case u t₂ t₃, Red.case step hb₂ hb₃⟩
  case sub => grind
  case abs => grind
  case tabs => grind

lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have : Typing Γ t τ := der
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var => grind
  case app t₁ _ _ t₂ l r ih_l ih_r =>
    right
    rcases ih_l rfl l with val_l | ⟨t₁', red_l⟩
    · rcases ih_r rfl r with val_r | ⟨t₂', red_r⟩
      · obtain ⟨σ, u, h⟩ := l.canonical_form_abs val_l
        use u ^ᵗᵗ t₂
        grind
      · exact ⟨t₁.app t₂', Red.appᵣ val_l red_r⟩
    · exact ⟨t₁'.app t₂, Red.appₗ r.wf.2.1 red_l⟩
  case tapp σ' d sub ih =>
    have lcσ : σ'.LC := (sub.wf [] σ' _).2.1.lc
    right
    rcases ih rfl d with val | ⟨u, step⟩
    · obtain ⟨δ, v, h⟩ := d.canonical_form_tabs val
      exact ⟨v ^ᵗᵞ σ', by grind⟩
    · exact ⟨.tapp u σ', Red.tapp lcσ step⟩
  case let' t₁ σ t₂ τ L der h ih _ =>
    have ⟨_, hb⟩ := Term.body_let.mp (Typing.let' L der h).wf.2.1
    right
    rcases ih rfl der with val | ⟨t₁', step⟩
    · exact ⟨t₂ ^ᵗᵗ t₁, Red.let_body val hb⟩
    · exact ⟨t₁'.let' t₂, Red.let_bind step hb⟩
  case inl der _ ih =>
    rcases ih rfl der with val | ⟨u, step⟩
    · grind
    · exact Or.inr ⟨.inl u, Red.inl step⟩
  case inr der _ ih =>
    rcases ih rfl der with val | ⟨u, step⟩
    · grind
    · exact Or.inr ⟨.inr u, Red.inr step⟩
  case case t₁ σ τ t₂ δ t₃ L der h₂ h₃ ih _ _ =>
    have ⟨_, hb₂, hb₃⟩ := Term.body_case.mp (Typing.case L der h₂ h₃).wf.2.1
    right
    rcases ih rfl der with val | ⟨u, step⟩
    · rcases der.canonical_form_sum val with ⟨v, h | h⟩
      · subst t₁
        cases val with
        | inl vv => exact ⟨t₂ ^ᵗᵗ v, Red.case_inl vv hb₂ hb₃⟩
      · subst t₁
        cases val with
        | inr vv => exact ⟨t₃ ^ᵗᵗ v, Red.case_inr vv hb₂ hb₃⟩
    · exact ⟨.case u t₂ t₃, Red.case step hb₂ hb₃⟩
  case sub => grind
  case abs => grind
  case tabs => grind
